sections.heading: C — Advanced Driver-Assistance Systems
sections.markdown:
## C — Advanced Driver-Assistance Systems

FACT_ID: sec09-F01 | anchor: A01
Assistance features like auto braking, blind-spot watch, and crash warnings raise safety only when used right within their limits, and you must still drive unassisted since tech can fail, need shutoff, or vanish in another car [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec09-F02 | anchor: A01
Test day welcomes safety helpers such as backup cameras but bars convenience helpers such as adaptive cruise [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec09-F03 | anchor: A01
Permitted warning systems span backup alerts, blind-spot monitors, rear, sideview, and surround cameras, curve-speed warnings, bike, pedestrian, and obstacle detection, crash warnings, speed alerts, lane-departure warnings, parking sensors, and rear cross-traffic alerts [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec09-F04 | anchor: A01
Permitted assists cover auto emergency braking, auto reverse braking, lane keeping, and left-turn crash avoidance, while adaptive cruise and auto parallel parking stay banned [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec09-F05 | anchor: A02
Warning systems flash, beep, or buzz about looming crashes or faults yet stay mostly passive, leaving the save to you [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec09-F06 | anchor: A02
Backup warnings scan astern in reverse with sound or buzz, yet you still work side mirrors, rearview, head turns, and cameras [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec09-F07 | anchor: A02
Blind-spot monitors flag hidden alongside cars by symbol, sound, or buzz with extra scolding if you signal into them, yet lane changes still demand mirrors, head turns, and the monitor together [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec09-F08 | anchor: A03
Rear cameras paint a wide astern view on consoles, mirrors, or visors in reverse, yet never replace mirrors and head turns [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec09-F09 | anchor: A03
Sideview cameras stream the beside lane on signal or button, may stand in for mirrors, may sleep while backing or at speed, and still pair with mirrors and head turns [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec09-F10 | anchor: A03
Surround-view fuses four wide cameras, nose, tail, left, and right, into a bird's-eye parking picture, yet still pairs with mirrors and head turns [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec09-F11 | anchor: A04
Detection alerts flag bikes, walkers, and obstacles at low speeds near 25 mph, some only dead ahead and same-direction with a few auto-braking, yet never replace your own scanning, especially downtown [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec09-F12 | anchor: A04
Radar eyes fore, aft, or both judge closing gaps with beeps, flashes, buzzes, or brake pulses that quicken as you near, turning solid-toned when impact looms [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec09-F13 | anchor: A04
Curve-speed warnings track pace and place by GPS to scold hot curve and exit entries, yet you still carry a safe speed yourself [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec09-F14 | anchor: A04
Sensors must stay clean to sense at all [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec09-F15 | anchor: A05
Crash warnings flag slower or stopped obstacles ahead for timely braking or swerving without braking for you, while you keep distance and caution regardless [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec09-F16 | anchor: A05
The system sweeps 20 times per second out to 500 feet, granting about 3 seconds of warning at 15 to 18 mph, 4 seconds at 18 to 50 mph, and 5 seconds past 50 mph [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec09-F17 | anchor: A05
With current GPS data the speeding alert beeps or flashes, calling for a gentle lift or light braking rather than a slam, yet you still watch your own speed and obey limits [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec09-F18 | anchor: A05
Lane-departure warnings buzz, flash, or beep drifting cars back toward center using painted lines, yet never hold your lane for you [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec09-F19 | anchor: A06
Parking sensors beep faster as objects near with a solid tone at closest range yet miss flat, low, near, or far items, while cross-traffic alerts warn of crossing cars when backing; both still pair with mirrors, head turns, and cameras [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec09-F20 | anchor: A06
Assist systems shoulder part of driving, braking or steering with or for you, though you may still need to act [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec09-F21 | anchor: A06
Auto emergency braking senses dawdling or halted traffic and objects ahead, braking hard when you fail to, while you keep scanning and spacing [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec09-F22 | anchor: A07
Auto reverse braking beeps or flashes at rear obstacles while backing, then brakes itself if you ignore it, yet still pairs with mirrors, head turns, and cameras [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec09-F23 | anchor: A07
Lane keeping alerts drifting cars, then nudges the wheel home unless you override, but quits on faint, snowy, or dirty lines and never excuses your own control [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec09-F24 | anchor: A07
Left-turn avoidance watches oncoming traffic on slow lefts, sounding and braking and even freezing forward motion when gaps run short, yet you still judge the turn yourself [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec09-F25 | anchor: A08
Convenience features demand no testable skill, so none may run during the driving test [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec09-F26 | anchor: A08
Adaptive cruise holds your chosen short, medium, or long gap, slowing and even stopping and restarting in jams, yet demands your attention and rests in bad weather [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec09-F27 | anchor: A08
Auto parallel parking finds the slot and talks you through pulling ahead, reversing, and releasing the wheel, while you brake, watch, and finish the alignment [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec09-F28 | anchor: A08
Study the owner manual for every new feature and quiz the dealer on leftovers [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0033]

Misconceptions: a warning system only warns and never brakes for you; test day allows safety cameras but bans cruise and self-parking; faded lane paint silences lane-keeping help.

Mnemonic: warnings whisper, assists act, conveniences sit out test day; cameras aid, mirrors rule, shoulders check.

Glossary: forward collision warning (an alert of slower or stopped traffic ahead); blind spot monitor (a lane-change warning for hidden alongside cars); around-view monitor (a stitched bird's-eye parking view); adaptive cruise control (speed control holding a set following gap).

Dynamic facts: none in these pages; every assistance-system rule above is stable handbook knowledge with no date-variable or place-variable values.
